name: URY admin data table
describe: Report DataTable: rounded-lg border, bg-muted/50 header row (12px/500 text-tertiary), 12.5px body rows on hairline dividers, numeric columns end-aligned with tabular numerals, and a bold totals row. Row tone washes mark danger, warning or selected rows.

Use for every report and list grid in the admin app; the totals row is added when a report sums its rows. Arabic comes from ury/translations/ar.csv; "Amount", the item, group, branch and breakup names and the sample dates are translated here because ar.csv has no usable entry. "# Orders" and "% of Total" are hard-coded English in the source and stay English. Header cells follow data-table.tsx (12px/500 text-tertiary).
